statement: The characterisation bench named as the proof that slice 0 moves no number (PropertyRouteBench.cpp:390-516) covers liquid viscosity, surface tension, liquid diffusivity and density on catalogue records only; slice 0 also re-reads liquid conductivity, vapour pressure and the heat capacities, and 365 of 371 water dictionaries read sealed copies the bench never sees.

The byte-identity list of the record's 5.4 omits the model words written at operation level in five property dictionaries (Vogel 7, Andrade 3, StoredCorrelation 23, BrockBird 15, chemsepEq16 6, SatoRiedel 1).

Four kinds of legacy word are not a pin of a record law of that name: SatoRiedel and BrockBird are predictive; StoredCorrelation falls back per component to Brock-Bird, announced (StoredCorrelation.cpp:46-56), so forms are mixed per component today for surface tension; the words are case-insensitive aliases.

With no model word the liquid-transport factories default to Andrade, StoredCorrelation and SatoRiedel; no case reaches those defaults today only because ThermoPackageBuilder.cpp:2176 throws on a missing word.  The record's new reading of a word-less block lives at that line: relaxing it without deleting the factory defaults silently selects Andrade instead of the preferred law.

Record facts are injected across law blocks (Tc, Pc, omega, Tb into vapour pressure, Component.cpp:531-542; the whole ideal-gas heat-capacity block into the liquid one for RowlinsonBondi, :775-779), a second reader reads a salt's liquidHeatCapacity directly (ThermoPackageBuilder.cpp:765-766), and pureFluids wins over a transport word for a pure phase; the record's reading of several laws does not say which law is injected or read there.
A relative slope jump at a joint is ill-conditioned where the slope is near zero (ozone +237 %); print the jump in d ln Cp / d ln T instead.

The staged flip of water's vapour pressure omits that the stored water pairs were regressed on the present law: 24 molecular pair records with fittedInCase (NRTL 15, Wilson 7, UNIQUAC 2) and 89 electrolyte pairs; the fitting cases need their own stage and a ruling on refitting before their consumers are re-sealed.
The record places the provenance entry misfiled inside pcsaft{} at water.dat:296; that line is inside cosmo{}; the pcsaft one is propane.dat:149.

34 more misfiled provenance entries sit in sealed copies in 31 cases (30 in water's copy); moving the catalogue's 74 does not reach them, and the gate proposed for slice 0 fails on them or must state it reads the catalogue only.
